test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I goes / to school / every day / irrespective of the weather.
solution:
The erroneous part is option 2) i.e. 'I goes.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part 'I goes'
 
• We can note that the subject of the sentence is** 'I'** which is a **first-person singular number.**
 
• Therefore we should not add 's/es' after the verb. 
 
• So the correct verb will be** 'go.'**
 
• In the given sentence we need to use 'go' instead of 'goes' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct sentence:__ ***I go** to school every day irrespective of the weather.*
